title: PP1 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #4

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: PP1
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Refusing to help a neighbour
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Which response best shows understanding of Pillars of Islam? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Pillars of Islam.
   B. Use Pillars of Islam to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Pillars of Islam with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Pillars of Islam has no place in daily life.

3. Which response best shows understanding of The Arabic? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The Arabic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The Arabic has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Arabic.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Say Surah has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Surah.
   D. Use Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Toileting? (1 mark)
   A. Say Toileting has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Toileting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Toileting.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Eid? (1 mark)
   A. Use Eid to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Eid.
   C. Say Eid has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in Allah? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Belief in Allah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in Allah.
   D. Use Belief in Allah to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Pollute rivers deliberately
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Destroy trees without planting

9. Which response best shows understanding of Islamic? (1 mark)
   A. Use Islamic to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Islamic has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Islamic.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Relationship? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Relationship.
   B. Say Relationship has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Relationship to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Cheating in exams
   B. Spreading rumours
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. Which response best shows understanding of Belief in His? (1 mark)
   A. Say Belief in His has no place in daily life.
   B. Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Belief in His.
   D. Use Belief in His to insult classmates of other faiths.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Islamic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Eid and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Arabic and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

3. A — Apply the teaching of The Arabic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

4. B — Apply the teaching of Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. C — Apply the teaching of Toileting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

6. D — Apply the teaching of Eid with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

7. A — Apply the teaching of Belief in Allah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

8. C — Care for the environment and use resources wisely

9. C — Apply the teaching of Islamic with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

10. D — Apply the teaching of Relationship with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. D — Telling the truth and keeping trust

12. B — Apply the teaching of Belief in His with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

16. (4 marks)
